thesis: The vocabulary fixes distinctions among mechanisms, predictive memory, equivalence, approximation and cost.

ideas.statement: Predictive state differs from generative state, and sufficiency must include update closure without silently recovering discarded history.
Observational and interventional equivalence, approximate closeness and bounded indistinguishability impose different obligations.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Model error and statistical uncertainty about estimating it are distinct quantities.
